desc: Derive the operation on four ordered coordinates: it swaps the two outer gaps while preserving the middle gap.
Prove that operations generate arbitrary permutations within odd-indexed gaps and within even-indexed gaps, with no mixing between parity classes.
Reduce the objective to a weighted gap sum and apply the rearrangement inequality: each parity class is optimally sorted in ascending order by gap index.
Implement and validate the \(O(N\log N)\) exact-integer algorithm against the public samples.
Provide the final Python program with stdin parsing and stdout output in the required delimiters.
